candidates.change: Design A: broad rosy nose and flushed cheeks, relaxed sleepy eyes, crooked warm grin, slightly messy cheek fur. A rounded soft belly under an untidy open dark-teal sleeveless vest, loose sand trousers, rust sash tied askew. request.description:
Redesign this same adult tiger martial artist into a clearly recognizable lovable drunken brawler. Preserve the broad tiger face, amber striped fur, cream muzzle and crisp rounded pixel-art shading, but make the drunken character design and pose substantially different, not a tiny recolor. Full body almost front-facing, standing on both feet. The face must read tipsy at native size: reddish nose and cheek blush, heavy drooping brows, sleepy lopsided smiling squint. Adult comedic martial artist, not an infant or evil monster. Keep 64x64 transparent canvas, head, feet and any small prop entirely inside with margin, no background, floor, baked shadow, text or blur.
